refinements.name: 泠泠连奏
refinements.description: [普通攻击]命中敌人时，获得1层[茶劲]，每层[茶劲]使装备者的冲击力提升0.7%，最多叠加30层，持续8秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间；获得[茶劲]时，若装备者拥有的[茶劲]层数大于等于15层，全队角色造成的伤害提升20%，持续10秒，同名被动效果之间不可叠加。
refinements.descriptionEn: When a Basic Attack hits an enemy, gain 1 stack of Tea-riffic. Each stack of Tea-riffic increases the user's Impact by 0.7%, stacking up to 30 times, and lasting for 8s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Upon acquiring Tea-riffic, if the equipper possesses stacks of Tea-riffic greater than or equal to 15, all squad members' DMG is increased by 20% for 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

basic.name: 普通攻击：一煞
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 可以维持连击，持续打击敌人，在此期间发动[闪避]，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
第三段攻击期间，停止点按 【普通攻击键】 将会中断连击，自动衔接第四段攻击，维持连击超过一定时间后，第四段攻击将会得到强化；
第三、第四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing [Basic Attack] to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

special.name: 特殊技：昼锦堂
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑，随后发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：月上海棠
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑后腾空跃起，转身连打后发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害，长按 【强化特殊技键】 时，可以额外消耗能量，提升转身连打的攻击次数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：意不尽
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
腾空跃起后发动下落攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：太平令
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围区域发动强力连续打击，造成大量电属性伤害；
攻击命中敌人时，目标每拥有一层[核心被动：千秋岁]中的[羁服]，招式对其造成的伤害提升3%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive Electric DMG
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：八声甘州
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围区域发动强力连续打击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：风入松
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
腾空跃起后发动下落攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：锦上花
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：清江引
assistFollowup.nameEn: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方快速突进攻击并向地面注入电能，随后拔起引发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 青衣在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，会对敌人施加5层[羁服]，最多叠加20层，每层[羁服]能够使目标的失衡易伤倍率提升4%；在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中每发动一次突进攻击，终结一击将额外施加1层[羁服]，在发动终结一击时，若触发[极限闪避]，可以直接施加10层[羁服]；对普通或精英敌人施加[羁服]时，施加的层数翻倍；目标从失衡状态恢复时，对应[羁服]层数重置。
facts.textEn: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 4%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies 10 stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.

cinema.name: 介电击穿
cinema.description: 青衣进入战场时，立即使[闪络电压]回复至上限，并使其后继累积效率提升30%；发动[普通攻击：醉花月云转]时，若[闪络电压]已累积至上限，则使本次招式命中的敌人防御力降低15%，且自身对该目标的暴击率提升20%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.

cinema.name: 四两拨千斤
cinema.description: [核心被动：千秋岁]中每层[羁服]提供的失衡易伤倍率提升效果提升至原本的135%；青衣攻击命中敌人时，若对其施加的[羁服]已叠加至层数上限，则自身对其造成的失衡值提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.

cinema.name: 多喝热水
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 稳态电弧屏障
cinema.description: 进入或退出[闪络]状态时，获得等同于青衣10%生命值上限的护盾；护盾效果刷新时，如果上一次获得的护盾仍然存在，则为青衣回复5点能量，能量回复效果10秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.

cinema.name: 童心未泯
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 奇经八脉
cinema.description: [普通攻击：醉花月云转]的打断等级大幅提升，招式的暴击伤害额外提升100%；青衣[普通攻击：醉花月云转]命中敌人时，目标的全属性伤害抗性降低20%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.

向前方发动一次突进攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

basic.name: 闪络
basic.description: 青衣发动招式造成电属性伤害时，会累积[闪络电压]，当[闪络电压]累积至75%时，青衣将进入[闪络]状态。发动[普通攻击：醉花月云转]时，青衣会消耗所有[闪络电压]并退出[闪络]状态，所消耗的[闪络电压]中超过75%的部分，每1%能够使本次招式造成的伤害/失衡值额外提升1%/0.5%。[普通攻击：醉花月云转]本身不会累积[闪络电压]。
basic.descriptionEn: When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

basic.name: 普通攻击：醉花月云转
basic.description:
[闪络]状态下，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方连续发动五次突进攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害，招式发动期间松开 【普通攻击键】 ，可以提前发动终结一击；
在角色即将受到攻击时发动终结一击，可以触发[极限闪避]；
突进攻击发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%，终结一击发动期间具有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
During the Flash Connect state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive Electric DMG. Release [Basic Attack] during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger Perfect Dodge.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：入破
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进后发动上挑攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：昼锦堂
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑，随后发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：月上海棠
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方快速上挑后腾空跃起，转身连打后发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害，长按 【强化特殊技键】 时，可以额外消耗能量，提升转身连打的攻击次数；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第三段[普通攻击]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

ultimate.name: 终结技：八声甘州
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围区域发动强力连续打击，随后发动终结一击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：风入松
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
腾空跃起后发动下落攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

125100001.name: 普通攻击：一煞
125100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 可以维持连击，持续打击敌人，在此期间发动[闪避]，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数；
第三段攻击期间，停止点按 【普通攻击键】 将会中断连击，自动衔接第四段攻击，维持连击超过一定时间后，第四段攻击将会得到强化；
第三、第四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
125100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing [Basic Attack] to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

125100003.name: 闪络
125100003.description: 青衣发动招式造成电属性伤害时，会累积[闪络电压]，当[闪络电压]累积至75%时，青衣将进入[闪络]状态。发动[普通攻击：醉花月云转]时，青衣会消耗所有[闪络电压]并退出[闪络]状态，所消耗的[闪络电压]中超过75%的部分，每1%能够使本次招式造成的伤害/失衡值额外提升1%/0.5%。[普通攻击：醉花月云转]本身不会累积[闪络电压]。
125100003.descriptionEn: When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

1251-core-14.name: 核心被动：千秋岁
1251-core-14.description: 青衣在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中发动终结一击命中敌人时，会对敌人施加5层[羁服]，最多叠加20层，每层[羁服]能够使目标的失衡易伤倍率提升2%；在[普通攻击：醉花月云转]中每发动一次突进攻击，终结一击将额外施加1层[羁服]，在发动终结一击时，若触发[极限闪避]，可以直接施加10层[羁服]；对普通或精英敌人施加[羁服]时，施加的层数翻倍；目标从失衡状态恢复时，对应[羁服]层数重置。
1251-core-14.descriptionEn: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 2%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply 1 extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies 10 stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.
